text: dsh-archive-manager 是一个面向 DSH Web 的归档会话管理插件，会在侧栏底部加入“已归档”入口，并用面板集中查看按工作区整理的归档会话。用户可以打开会话继续对话、取消归档并恢复原有工作区归属，也可以在确认后删除会话记录。面板支持按标题、工作区和消息内容搜索，切换工作区分组或单列表、手动或最近更新排序，并拖动调整顺序。界面提供中英文显示；删除时会先处理活动代理和日志，再更新归档及工作区状态。适合需要整理或找回 DSH Web 历史会话的用户，使用 DSH Web 会话与持久化服务，不需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-archive-manager manages archived DSH Web sessions in a sidebar panel. Browse by workspace, reopen or restore a session, or confirm deletion. Search titles and message content; switch views, sort, or drag to reorder. It supports English and Chinese and uses DSH session services.
想把侧栏里已经归档的 DSH 会话找回来继续聊。
有没有办法查看被隐藏起来的历史会话？
我想把误归档的会话恢复到原来的工作区。
怎么彻底删除已经归档的会话和它的记录？
想按工作区整理归档会话，还能改成最近更新排序。
How can I search the contents of my archived chat sessions?
I need to restore or permanently remove old DSH Web sessions.
dsh-archive-manager 的功能「浏览归档会话」：点击侧栏底部的“已归档”入口打开面板，可按工作区分组查看会话，也可切换为单列表。
dsh-archive-manager 的功能「搜索归档会话」：在面板搜索会话标题、工作区名称和消息内容，点击结果可重新打开会话继续对话。
dsh-archive-manager 的功能「恢复会话」：在归档面板对会话执行恢复，将其从归档集合移除并放回工作区。
dsh-archive-manager 的功能「删除会话」：通过确认对话框发起删除；宿主处理活动代理、会话日志及工作区归档状态。
dsh-archive-manager 的功能「同步视图和顺序」：切换工作区或单列表、手动或最近更新排序，并拖动调整会话位置。
dsh-archive-manager 使用前须知：若插件热重载时有会话代理仍在运行，代理控制句柄可能已丢失，删除会被拒绝并要求重启 DSH 后重试。
归档后的对话太多了，想通过消息内容快速找到某一条。

dsh-archive-manager README · dsh-archive-manager：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

An archived-session manager for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) WebUI: an "Archived" entry at the sidebar footer opens a grouped archive panel — open a session to continue it, unarchive, or delete it (full live-agent teardown + physical log removal).

Native DSH only has the "archive" action (hides the session from the sidebar); there is no way to view, restore, or delete archived sessions. This plugin fills that gap.

dsh-archive-manager README · Features：- **Archive list** — an "Archived" entry at the sidebar footer opens a panel grouping sessions by workspace, visually matching the official sidebar
- **Continue a session** — click an archived session to open it and keep chatting; its archived state is untouched
- **Unarchive** — put a session back into its workspace with one click, original position preserved
- **Delete for good** — safely stops the session first, then removes its complete on-disk record; a confirmation dialog guards the action
- **Search** — instant filtering by title or workspace, plus message search (your prompts and the assistant's replies); behaves like the official search
- **View sync** — grouping (by workspace / one list), ordering (manual / recently updated), and drag-to-reorder all stay in real-time two-way sync with the official sidebar
- **Bilingual UI** — English and Chinese, following the system language automatically
- Session status at a glance: running / completed / waiting for you — same as the official sidebar

dsh-archive-manager README · Compatibility：Developed against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.0-rc.6**. Relies on official internal shapes (`workspaceRegistry.enqueueOperation`, `AgentHandle.dispose`, the client-runtime service shapes); a dsh upgrade may require adaptation — if something misbehaves after upgrading, check whether this repo has caught up with the new version.

dsh-archive-manager README · Install：From npm:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archive-manager
```

dsh-archive-manager README · Updating：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-archive-manager
```

dsh-archive-manager README · Uninstall：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-archive-manager
```

Then restart dsh web.

dsh-archive-manager README · Known limitations：- Sessions that were running while the plugin itself was **hot-reloaded** cannot be deleted afterwards — the plugin will refuse with a clear message asking you to restart dsh first. (Normal use is unaffected: install once, and everything — including sessions archived before the plugin existed — stays manageable.)
